sections.title: Integrated YKI-style communication clinic: meaning and form
body: Goal: Combine service language, reactions, narration and opinion in four original intermediate-level tasks.

Core vocabulary: en uppgiftstyp, relevant, sammanfatta. Key phrases: Jag kontaktar er eftersom kursen har ställts in. · Vad tråkigt! Finns det ett annat tillfälle? · Jag anser att deltagarna bör erbjudas ett alternativ.

Choose structure by task: service response = need, details, request; reaction = acknowledgement plus follow-up; narrative = setting, turn, action, result; opinion = claim, reason, example, conclusion. Reuse language flexibly, but never force a memorised answer into a different situation.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

sections.title: Register, evidence and independent use
body: Register model: “Jag kontaktar er eftersom kursen har ställts in.” is a formal-neutral service opening way to express “I am contacting you because the course has been cancelled.”.
For listening and reading, answer from a specific word or phrase. For speaking and writing, make the recipient, purpose and next action clear.
Attempt the task before using the model. Improve one high-impact feature, then perform it again with the transfer condition.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: What must the listener do to keep the possible place? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: By when must participants communicate their choice? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: Complete two timed tasks: leave a service message about the cancelled course, then tell a friend what happened and react to the friend's alternative suggestion. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Complete two short texts: a 90-word request to the institute and a 120-word opinion on whether cancelled courses should always offer an alternative. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: The institution offers a different course, not a refund; decide whether it meets your needs and respond with reasons.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.

Notice: Choose structure by task: service response = need, details, request; reaction = acknowledgement plus follow-up; narrative = setting, turn, action, result; opinion = claim, reason, example, conclusion.
Transfer the pattern: The institution offers a different course, not a refund; decide whether it meets your needs and respond with reasons.
